The {item:Marlin} is a rare fish associated with the island of {wiki:Goroma|Goroma}. Take it to the fisherman {npc:Pemaret}, on the Cormaya boat, and he turns it into a {item:Marlin Trophy} for you to decorate your house wall.
The Marlin is a rare fish; you may find a collector to trade it with.
The quest area is {wiki:Goroma|Goroma}: there you will find {creature:Island Troll|Island Trolls}, {creature:Crab|Crabs}, {creature:Cobra|Cobras} and {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}.

{wiki:Goroma|Goroma} is an island northwest of **Liberty Bay**. At the Liberty Bay harbour, talk to Captain {npc:Jack Fate} and ask for passage to Goroma: {key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes} (500 gp). He drops you off at his ship, on the **east** coast of Goroma.

The paid trip to Goroma only becomes available after you have done *Access to Goroma* from the {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest|The Shattered Isles Quest} (get shipwrecked on the way to Thais at level 20+ and give 30 {item:Wood} to Jack Fate). If you get shipwrecked there without that access, you can only leave after handing him the 30 Wood.
Get a {item:Marlin}, a rare fish. The location of this quest is the island of {wiki:Goroma|Goroma}.
On Goroma there are {creature:Island Troll|Island Trolls}, {creature:Crab|Crabs}, {creature:Cobra|Cobras} and {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}.
In Goroma's creature list, the {item:Marlin} appears as a very rare loot from {creature:Island Troll|Island Trolls}.
Go back to {npc:Jack Fate}'s ship on the **east** coast of the island ({coord:32161,32558,6}) and say {key:hi}, {key:passage} and {key:yes}. He takes you back to **Liberty Bay**.
2. Trading the Marlin for the trophy

{wiki:Cormaya|Cormaya} is a small island south of **Edron**. On the boat in the **north** of Edron, talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (20 gp). {npc:Pemaret} is at the **north** harbour of Cormaya, next to Cormaya Street.
You can also reach Cormaya by the steamship from Kazordoon or Farmine, or on foot through the {wiki:Edron Rotworm Cave|Edron Rotworm Cave}.
Go to the boat in **Cormaya** (near Edron), 1 floor up, and talk to {npc:Pemaret}. Say {key:hi}, {key:marlin} and {key:yes}. He turns your Marlin into a wall decoration.
To return to **Edron**, ask {npc:Pemaret} himself for the trip: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (20 gp).
